========== FILE: migrations/0001_auth.sql ==========

-- Better Auth schema (identity + sessions for "Sign in with Grok").
--
-- Generated by the Better Auth CLI for its Postgres adapter — DO NOT EDIT by
-- hand. `@/lib/auth/server` runs Better Auth against these tables when
-- DATABASE_URL is set. The columns are camelCase and MUST stay double-quoted so
-- Postgres preserves the case Better Auth queries by.
--
-- Migrations in this folder are the single source of truth for your schema. They
-- apply to Neon during the Vercel build (`npm run build`) and to the local
-- PGLite fallback automatically on startup, so dev matches production. Applied
-- files are recorded by name in `_migrations` and NEVER run again.
--
-- Put YOUR app's schema in NEW ordered files (0002_*.sql, 0003_*.sql, …), never
-- in this one. For app tables, prefer snake_case and give per-user tables a
-- `user_id TEXT NOT NULL` column (TEXT, not UUID — the preview dev user id is
-- the string 'dev-user'), then scope every query to the authenticated user
-- server-side (see the `neon` + `auth` skills and src/lib/auth/verify.server.ts).

create table if not exists "user" (
  "id" text not null primary key,
  "name" text not null,
  "email" text not null unique,
  "emailVerified" boolean not null,
  "image" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP not null,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP not null
);

create table if not exists "session" (
  "id" text not null primary key,
  "expiresAt" timestamptz not null,
  "token" text not null unique,
  "createdAt" timestamptz default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP not null,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz not null,
  "ipAddress" text,
  "userAgent" text,
  "userId" text not null references "user" ("id") on delete cascade
);

create table if not exists "account" (
  "id" text not null primary key,
  "accountId" text not null,
  "providerId" text not null,
  "userId" text not null references "user" ("id") on delete cascade,
  "accessToken" text,
  "refreshToken" text,
  "idToken" text,
  "accessTokenExpiresAt" timestamptz,
  "refreshTokenExpiresAt" timestamptz,
  "scope" text,
  "password" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP not null,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz not null
);

create table if not exists "verification" (
  "id" text not null primary key,
  "identifier" text not null,
  "value" text not null,
  "expiresAt" timestamptz not null,
  "createdAt" timestamptz default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP not null,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP not null
);

create index if not exists "session_userId_idx" on "session" ("userId");
create index if not exists "account_userId_idx" on "account" ("userId");
create index if not exists "verification_identifier_idx" on "verification" ("identifier");


========== FILE: migrations/0002_crash.sql ==========

create table if not exists hospitals (
  id text primary key,
  name text not null,
  code text not null,
  created_by text not null,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

create table if not exists memberships (
  user_id text not null,
  hospital_id text not null references hospitals(id) on delete cascade,
  role text not null,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  primary key (user_id, hospital_id)
);

create table if not exists invites (
  id text primary key,
  hospital_id text not null references hospitals(id) on delete cascade,
  email text not null,
  role text not null,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  unique (hospital_id, email)
);

create table if not exists items (
  id text primary key,
  hospital_id text not null references hospitals(id) on delete cascade,
  name text not null,
  kind text not null,
  category text not null,
  strength text not null default '',
  is_active boolean not null default true,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

create table if not exists carts (
  id text primary key,
  hospital_id text not null references hospitals(id) on delete cascade,
  name text not null,
  location text not null,
  cart_type text not null,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

create table if not exists drawers (
  id text primary key,
  cart_id text not null references carts(id) on delete cascade,
  sort_order int not null,
  name text not null
);

create table if not exists cart_items (
  id text primary key,
  drawer_id text not null references drawers(id) on delete cascade,
  item_id text not null references items(id) on delete cascade,
  fixed_qty int not null default 1
);

create table if not exists audits (
  id text primary key,
  hospital_id text not null references hospitals(id) on delete cascade,
  cart_id text not null references carts(id) on delete cascade,
  audit_type text not null,
  auditor_id text not null,
  status text not null,
  remarks text not null default '',
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

create table if not exists audit_lines (
  id text primary key,
  audit_id text not null references audits(id) on delete cascade,
  cart_item_id text not null,
  item_name text not null,
  drawer_name text not null,
  fixed_qty int not null,
  line_status text not null,
  label_note text not null default '',
  remarks text not null default ''
);

create index if not exists memberships_user_idx on memberships (user_id);
create index if not exists items_hospital_idx on items (hospital_id);
create index if not exists carts_hospital_idx on carts (hospital_id);
create index if not exists audits_hospital_idx on audits (hospital_id);

========== FILE: src/routes/__root.tsx ==========

import { createRootRoute, HeadContent, Outlet, Scripts } from "@tanstack/react-router";
import { AuthProvider } from "@/lib/auth/provider";
import { PreviewHostBridge } from "@/components/preview-host-bridge";
import appCss from "../styles.css?url";

export const Route = createRootRoute({
  head: () => ({
    meta: [
      { charSet: "utf-8" },
      { name: "viewport", content: "width=device-width, initial-scale=1" },
      { title: "CartCheck" },
      { name: "theme-color", content: "#0e6b66" },
    ],
    links: [
      { rel: "icon", type: "image/svg+xml", href: "/favicon.svg" },
      { rel: "stylesheet", href: appCss },
      { rel: "manifest", href: "/__grok/manifest.webmanifest" },
      { rel: "apple-touch-icon", href: "/__grok/icon-180.png" },
    ],
  }),
  component: () => (
    <html lang="en" suppressHydrationWarning>
      <head>
        <HeadContent />
      </head>
      <body>
        <PreviewHostBridge />
        <AuthProvider>
          <Outlet />
        </AuthProvider>
        <Scripts />
      </body>
    </html>
  ),
});


========== FILE: src/routes/login.tsx ==========

import { createFileRoute, useNavigate } from "@tanstack/react-router";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { authClient, authEnabled } from "@/lib/auth/client";
import { useCurrentUserState } from "@/lib/auth/use-current-user";
import { ensureSuperAdmin } from "@/lib/crash/api";

export const Route = createFileRoute("/login")({ component: Login });

function Login() {
  const { user, isPending } = useCurrentUserState();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [loginId, setLoginId] = useState("SuperAdmin");
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    ensureSuperAdmin().catch(() => {});
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isPending && user) navigate({ to: "/" });
  }, [isPending, user, navigate]);

  async function onSubmit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    setBusy(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      await ensureSuperAdmin();
      const email =
        loginId.trim().toLowerCase() === "superadmin" ? "superadmin@cartcheck.local" : loginId.trim();
      const res = await authClient.signIn.email({ email, password, callbackURL: "/" });
      if (res.error) throw new Error(res.error.message || "Could not sign in");
      navigate({ to: "/" });
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Sign-in failed");
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <main className="mx-auto grid min-h-screen max-w-5xl items-center gap-10 px-4 py-12 md:grid-cols-2">
      <div>
        <p className="text-sm font-medium tracking-wide text-primary">Hospital pharmacy</p>
        <h1 className="mt-2 font-display text-5xl leading-tight text-ink">Crash carts, checked on time.</h1>
        <p className="mt-4 max-w-md text-muted">
          Super Admin opens hospitals. Each hospital’s trolleys have numbered floors. Every floor can hold
          medicines, surgicals, and miscellaneous items.
        </p>
      </div>
      <form className="space-y-3 rounded-card border border-line bg-surface p-5" onSubmit={onSubmit}>
        <h2 className="font-display text-2xl">Sign in</h2>
        {authEnabled ? (
          <>
            <label className="block text-sm">
              ID
              <input
                className="mt-1 min-h-11 w-full rounded-lg border border-line bg-bg px-3"
                value={loginId}
                onChange={(e) => setLoginId(e.target.value)}
                autoComplete="username"
                required
              />
            </label>
            <label className="block text-sm">
              Password
              <input
                type="password"
                className="mt-1 min-h-11 w-full rounded-lg border border-line bg-bg px-3"
                value={password}
                onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
                autoComplete="current-password"
                required
              />
            </label>
            {error ? <p className="text-sm text-warn">{error}</p> : null}
            <button
              type="submit"
              disabled={busy}
              className="min-h-11 w-full rounded-full bg-primary text-primary-ink disabled:opacity-60"
            >
              {busy ? "Please wait…" : "Sign in"}
            </button>
            <p className="text-sm text-muted">Super Admin ID is SuperAdmin. Staff sign in with the email they were invited with.</p>
          </>
        ) : (
          <p className="text-sm text-muted">Sign-in is disabled.</p>
        )}
      </form>
    </main>
  );
}


========== FILE: src/routes/index.tsx ==========

import { createFileRoute, Link } from "@tanstack/react-router";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { HospitalGate, type HospitalPick } from "@/components/shell";
import { getDashboard, inviteMember, listMembers, createHospital } from "@/lib/crash/api";
import { roleLabel } from "@/lib/crash/catalog";

export const Route = createFileRoute("/")({ component: Page });

function Page() {
  return (
    <HospitalGate
      title="Floor board"
      subtitle="Open audits, carts on the floor, and who can sign the checklist."
    >
      {(hospital) => <Board hospital={hospital} />}
    </HospitalGate>
  );
}

function Board({ hospital }: { hospital: HospitalPick }) {
  const [data, setData] = useState<Awaited<ReturnType<typeof getDashboard>> | null>(null);
  const [members, setMembers] = useState<Awaited<ReturnType<typeof listMembers>> | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [role, setRole] = useState("pharmacy");
  const [hospName, setHospName] = useState("");
  const [hospCode, setHospCode] = useState("");
  const [note, setNote] = useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    setData(null);
    Promise.all([getDashboard({ data: { hospitalId: hospital.id } }), listMembers({ data: { hospitalId: hospital.id } })])
      .then(([d, m]) => {
        setData(d);
        setMembers(m);
      })
      .catch((e: Error) => setError(e.message));
  }, [hospital.id]);

  if (error) return <p className="text-warn">{error}</p>;
  if (!data || !members) return <p className="text-muted">Loading floor…</p>;

  const cards = [
    { label: "Crash carts", value: data.cartCount },
    { label: "Open audits", value: data.openAudits },
    { label: "Open gaps", value: data.openGaps },
  ];

  return (
    <div className="grid gap-6 lg:grid-cols-[1.4fr_0.8fr]">
      <section className="space-y-4">
        <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3">
          {cards.map((c) => (
            <div key={c.label} className="rounded-card border border-line bg-surface p-4">
              <p className="text-sm text-muted">{c.label}</p>
              <p className="font-display text-3xl">{c.value}</p>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
        <div className="rounded-card border border-line bg-surface">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-line px-4 py-3">
            <h2 className="font-medium">Carts</h2>
            <Link to="/audits" className="text-sm text-primary">
              Start an audit
            </Link>
          </div>
          <ul>
            {data.carts.map((c) => (
              <li key={c.id} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 border-b border-line px-4 py-3 last:border-0">
                <div>
                  <p className="font-medium">{c.name}</p>
                  <p className="text-sm text-muted">
                    {c.cart_type} · {c.location}
                  </p>
                </div>
                <Link to="/carts/$cartId" params={{ cartId: c.id }} className="text-sm text-primary">
                  Layout
                </Link>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </div>
        <div className="rounded-card border border-line bg-surface">
          <h2 className="border-b border-line px-4 py-3 font-medium">Recent audits</h2>
          {data.recent.length === 0 ? (
            <p className="px-4 py-6 text-sm text-muted">No audits yet. Pharmacy or quality can start a monthly or quarterly check.</p>
          ) : (
            <ul>
              {data.recent.map((a) => (
                <li key={a.id} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 border-b border-line px-4 py-3 last:border-0">
                  <div>
                    <p className="font-medium">{a.cart_name}</p>
                    <p className="text-sm capitalize text-muted">
                      {a.audit_type} · {a.status}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                  <Link to="/audits/$auditId" params={{ auditId: a.id }} className="text-sm text-primary">
                    Open
                  </Link>
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          )}
        </div>
      </section>
      <aside className="space-y-4">
      {data.isSuper ? (
        <form
          className="rounded-card border border-line bg-surface p-4 space-y-2"
          onSubmit={async (e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            setNote("");
            try {
              await createHospital({ data: { name: hospName, code: hospCode } });
              setHospName("");
              setHospCode("");
              setNote("Hospital added. Switch to it from the menu.");
              window.location.reload();
            } catch (err) {
              setNote(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Could not add hospital");
            }
          }}
        >
          <h2 className="font-medium">Add hospital</h2>
          <input required value={hospName} onChange={(e) => setHospName(e.target.value)} placeholder="Hospital name" className="min-h-11 w-full rounded-lg border border-line bg-bg px-3" />
          <input required value={hospCode} onChange={(e) => setHospCode(e.target.value)} placeholder="Code" className="min-h-11 w-full rounded-lg border border-line bg-bg px-3 uppercase" />
          <button type="submit" className="min-h-11 w-full rounded-full bg-primary text-primary-ink">Add hospital</button>
        </form>
      ) : null}
      <div className="rounded-card border border-line bg-surface p-4">
        <h2 className="font-medium">People</h2>
        <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-muted">Your role here is {roleLabel(data.role)}.</p>
        <ul className="mt-3 space-y-2 text-sm">
          {members.members.map((m) => (
            <li key={m.email} className="flex justify-between gap-2">
              <span>{m.name || m.email}</span>
              <span className="text-muted">{roleLabel(m.role)}</span>
            </li>
          ))}
          {members.pending.map((m) => (
            <li key={m.email} className="flex justify-between gap-2 text-muted">
              <span>{m.email}</span>
              <span>Invited · {roleLabel(m.role)}</span>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
        {data.role === "hospital_admin" || data.role === "super_admin" ? (
          <form
            className="mt-4 space-y-2 border-t border-line pt-4"
            onSubmit={async (e) => {
              e.preventDefault();
              setNote("");
              try {
                const res = await inviteMember({ data: { hospitalId: hospital.id, email, role } });
                setNote(res.joined ? "Added to this hospital." : "Invite saved. They join when they sign up with that email.");
                setEmail("");
                setMembers(await listMembers({ data: { hospitalId: hospital.id } }));
              } catch (err) {
                setNote(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Could not invite");
              }
            }}
          >
            <p className="text-sm font-medium">Invite by email</p>
            <input
              type="email"
              required
              value={email}
              onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="pharmacy@hospital.org"
              className="min-h-11 w-full rounded-lg border border-line bg-bg px-3"
            />
            <select
              value={role}
              onChange={(e) => setRole(e.target.value)}
              className="min-h-11 w-full rounded-lg border border-line bg-bg px-3"
            >
              <option value="pharmacy">Pharmacy</option>
              <option value="quality">Quality</option>
              <option value="manager">Manager</option>
              <option value="hospital_admin">Hospital admin</option>
            </select>
            <button type="submit" className="min-h-11 w-full rounded-full bg-primary text-primary-ink">
              Invite
            </button>
            {note ? <p className="text-sm text-muted">{note}</p> : null}
          </form>
        ) : null}
      </div>
      </aside>
    </div>
  );
}


========== FILE: src/routes/items.tsx ==========

import { createFileRoute } from "@tanstack/react-router";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { HospitalGate, type HospitalPick } from "@/components/shell";
import { addItem, listItems } from "@/lib/crash/api";

export const Route = createFileRoute("/items")({ component: Page });

function Page() {
  return (
    <HospitalGate
      title="Item master"
      subtitle="Medicines and surgicals for this hospital. Assign them onto each cart’s drawers."
    >
      {(hospital) => <Items hospital={hospital} />}
    </HospitalGate>
  );
}

function Items({ hospital }: { hospital: HospitalPick }) {
  const [rows, setRows] = useState<Awaited<ReturnType<typeof listItems>> | null>(null);
  const [kind, setKind] = useState<"all" | "medicine" | "surgical" | "misc">("all");
  const [name, setName] = useState("");
  const [newKind, setNewKind] = useState("medicine");
  const [category, setCategory] = useState("");
  const [strength, setStrength] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  async function load() {
    setRows(await listItems({ data: { hospitalId: hospital.id } }));
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    load().catch((e: Error) => setError(e.message));
  }, [hospital.id]);

  if (error) return <p className="text-warn">{error}</p>;
  if (!rows) return <p className="text-muted">Loading items…</p>;

  const shown = rows.items.filter((i) => kind === "all" || i.kind === kind);
  const admin = rows.role === "hospital_admin" || rows.role === "super_admin";

  return (
    <div className="grid gap-6 lg:grid-cols-[1fr_280px]">
      <div>
        <div className="mb-3 flex gap-2">
          {(["all", "medicine", "surgical", "misc"] as const).map((k) => (
            <button
              key={k}
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setKind(k)}
              className={`min-h-11 rounded-full px-4 capitalize ${kind === k ? "bg-primary text-primary-ink" : "bg-surface border border-line"}`}
            >
              {k}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
        <ul className="divide-y divide-line overflow-hidden rounded-card border border-line bg-surface">
          {shown.map((item) => (
            <li key={item.id} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 px-4 py-3">
              <div>
                <p className="font-medium">{item.name}</p>
                <p className="text-sm text-muted">
                  {item.kind} · {item.category}
                  {item.strength ? ` · ${item.strength}` : ""}
                </p>
              </div>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      </div>
      {admin ? (
        <form
          className="h-fit space-y-3 rounded-card border border-line bg-surface p-4"
          onSubmit={async (e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            setError("");
            try {
              await addItem({
                data: { hospitalId: hospital.id, name, kind: newKind, category, strength },
              });
              setName("");
              setCategory("");
              setStrength("");
              await load();
            } catch (err) {
              setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Could not add");
            }
          }}
        >
          <h2 className="font-medium">Add to the list</h2>
          <input
            required
            value={name}
            onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Item name"
            className="min-h-11 w-full rounded-lg border border-line bg-bg px-3"
          />
          <select
            value={newKind}
            onChange={(e) => setNewKind(e.target.value)}
            className="min-h-11 w-full rounded-lg border border-line bg-bg px-3"
          >
            <option value="medicine">Medicine</option>
            <option value="surgical">Surgical</option>
            <option value="misc">Misc</option>
          </select>
          <input
            value={category}
            onChange={(e) => setCategory(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Category (ACLS, Airway…)"
            className="min-h-11 w-full rounded-lg border border-line bg-bg px-3"
          />
          <input
            value={strength}
            onChange={(e) => setStrength(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Strength (optional)"
            className="min-h-11 w-full rounded-lg border border-line bg-bg px-3"
          />
          <button type="submit" className="min-h-11 w-full rounded-full bg-primary text-primary-ink">
            Add item
          </button>
        </form>
      ) : (
        <p className="text-sm text-muted">Only a hospital admin can add medicines or surgicals.</p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}


========== FILE: src/routes/carts.tsx ==========

import { createFileRoute, Link } from "@tanstack/react-router";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { HospitalGate, type HospitalPick } from "@/components/shell";
import { createCart, listCarts } from "@/lib/crash/api";

export const Route = createFileRoute("/carts")({ component: Page });

function Page() {
  return (
    <HospitalGate
      title="Crash carts"
      subtitle="Each floor can keep a different fixed list. ICU, emergency, and wards do not have to match."
    >
      {(h) => <Carts hospital={h} />}
    </HospitalGate>
  );
}

function Carts({ hospital }: { hospital: HospitalPick }) {
  const [data, setData] = useState<Awaited<ReturnType<typeof listCarts>> | null>(null);
  const [name, setName] = useState("");
  const [location, setLocation] = useState("");
  const [cartType, setCartType] = useState("Ward");
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  async function load() {
    setData(await listCarts({ data: { hospitalId: hospital.id } }));
  }
  useEffect(() => {
    load().catch((e: Error) => setError(e.message));
  }, [hospital.id]);

  if (error) return <p className="text-warn">{error}</p>;
  if (!data) return <p className="text-muted">Loading carts…</p>;

  return (
    <div className="grid gap-6 lg:grid-cols-[1fr_280px]">
      <ul className="space-y-3">
        {data.carts.map((c) => (
          <li key={c.id} className="rounded-card border border-line bg-surface p-4">
            <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
              <div>
                <p className="font-medium">{c.name}</p>
                <p className="text-sm text-muted">
                  {c.cart_type} · {c.location}
                </p>
                <p className="mt-2 text-sm">
                  {c.drawers} floors · {c.lines} items
                </p>
              </div>
              <Link
                to="/carts/$cartId"
                params={{ cartId: c.id }}
                className="inline-flex min-h-11 items-center rounded-full bg-primary px-4 text-sm text-primary-ink"
              >
                Open
              </Link>
            </div>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
      {data.role === "hospital_admin" || data.role === "super_admin" ? (
        <form
          className="h-fit space-y-3 rounded-card border border-line bg-surface p-4"
          onSubmit={async (e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            try {
              await createCart({ data: { hospitalId: hospital.id, name, location, cartType } });
              setName("");
              setLocation("");
              await load();
            } catch (err) {
              setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Could not create cart");
            }
          }}
        >
          <h2 className="font-medium">New trolley</h2>
          <input
            required
            value={name}
            onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="OT Crash Cart"
            className="min-h-11 w-full rounded-lg border border-line bg-bg px-3"
          />
          <input
            required
            value={location}
            onChange={(e) => setLocation(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Operation theatre"
            className="min-h-11 w-full rounded-lg border border-line bg-bg px-3"
          />
          <select
            value={cartType}
            onChange={(e) => setCartType(e.target.value)}
            className="min-h-11 w-full rounded-lg border border-line bg-bg px-3"
          >
            {["ICU", "Emergency", "Ward", "OT", "Other"].map((t) => (
              <option key={t}>{t}</option>
            ))}
          </select>
          <button type="submit" className="min-h-11 w-full rounded-full bg-primary text-primary-ink">
            Add cart
          </button>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted">New carts start with four empty floors. Add medicine, surgical, or misc on any floor.</p>
        </form>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}


========== FILE: src/routes/carts.$cartId.tsx ==========

import { createFileRoute, Link } from "@tanstack/react-router";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { HospitalGate, type HospitalPick } from "@/components/shell";
import { addFloorItem, getCart } from "@/lib/crash/api";

export const Route = createFileRoute("/carts/$cartId")({ component: Page });

function Page() {
  const { cartId } = Route.useParams();
  return (
    <HospitalGate title="Cart layout" subtitle="Each floor can hold medicines, surgicals, and miscellaneous items.">
      {(h) => <Layout hospital={h} cartId={cartId} />}
    </HospitalGate>
  );
}

function Layout({ hospital, cartId }: { hospital: HospitalPick; cartId: string }) {
  const [data, setData] = useState<Awaited<ReturnType<typeof getCart>> | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  async function load() {
    const next = await getCart({ data: { hospitalId: hospital.id, cartId } });
    setData(next);
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    load().catch((e: Error) => setError(e.message));
  }, [hospital.id, cartId]);

  if (error) return <p className="text-warn">{error}</p>;
  if (!data) return <p className="text-muted">Loading layout…</p>;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-end justify-between gap-3">
        <div>
          <p className="font-display text-2xl">{data.cart.name}</p>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted">
            {data.cart.cart_type} · {data.cart.location}
          </p>
        </div>
        <Link to="/audits" className="inline-flex min-h-11 items-center rounded-full border border-line bg-surface px-4 text-sm">
          Audit this cart
        </Link>
      </div>
      <div className="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2">
        {data.drawers.map((d) => (
          <FloorCard
            key={d.id}
            name={d.name}
            lines={data.lines.filter((l) => l.drawer_id === d.id)}
            canEdit={data.role === "hospital_admin" || data.role === "super_admin"}
            onAdd={async (input) => {
              await addFloorItem({
                data: { hospitalId: hospital.id, drawerId: d.id, ...input },
              });
              await load();
            }}
          />
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function FloorCard({
  name,
  lines,
  canEdit,
  onAdd,
}: {
  name: string;
  lines: { id: string; name: string; kind: string; strength: string; fixed_qty: number }[];
  canEdit: boolean;
  onAdd: (input: { name: string; kind: string; strength: string; qty: number }) => Promise<void>;
}) {
  const [kind, setKind] = useState("medicine");
  const [itemName, setItemName] = useState("");
  const [strength, setStrength] = useState("");
  const [qty, setQty] = useState(1);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  return (
    <section className="rounded-card border border-line bg-surface">
      <h2 className="border-b border-line px-4 py-3 font-medium">{name}</h2>
      <ul>
        {lines.map((l) => (
          <li key={l.id} className="border-b border-line px-4 py-2 text-sm last:border-0">
            <span className="font-medium">{l.name}</span>
            <span className="text-muted">
              {" "}
              · {l.kind}
              {l.strength ? ` · ${l.strength}` : ""} · qty {l.fixed_qty}
            </span>
          </li>
        ))}
        {lines.length === 0 ? <li className="px-4 py-4 text-sm text-muted">Nothing on this floor yet.</li> : null}
      </ul>
      {canEdit ? (
        <form
          className="space-y-2 border-t border-line p-3"
          onSubmit={async (e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            setError("");
            try {
              await onAdd({ name: itemName, kind, strength, qty });
              setItemName("");
              setStrength("");
              setQty(1);
            } catch (err) {
              setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Could not add");
            }
          }}
        >
          <div className="flex gap-1">
            {[
              ["medicine", "Medicine"],
              ["surgical", "Surgical"],
              ["misc", "Misc"],
            ].map(([id, label]) => (
              <button
                key={id}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setKind(id)}
                className={`min-h-10 flex-1 rounded-full text-sm ${kind === id ? "bg-primary text-primary-ink" : "bg-bg"}`}
              >
                {label}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
          <input
            required
            value={itemName}
            onChange={(e) => setItemName(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Item name"
            className="min-h-11 w-full rounded-lg border border-line bg-bg px-3"
          />
          <div className="flex gap-2">
            <input
              value={strength}
              onChange={(e) => setStrength(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Strength"
              className="min-h-11 min-w-0 flex-1 rounded-lg border border-line bg-bg px-3"
            />
            <input
              type="number"
              min={1}
              value={qty}
              onChange={(e) => setQty(Number(e.target.value))}
              className="min-h-11 w-20 rounded-lg border border-line bg-bg px-3"
            />
          </div>
          {error ? <p className="text-sm text-warn">{error}</p> : null}
          <button type="submit" className="min-h-11 w-full rounded-full bg-primary text-sm text-primary-ink">
            Add to this floor
          </button>
        </form>
      ) : null}
    </section>
  );
}


========== FILE: src/routes/audits.tsx ==========

import { createFileRoute, useNavigate } from "@tanstack/react-router";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { HospitalGate, type HospitalPick } from "@/components/shell";
import { listAudits, startAudit } from "@/lib/crash/api";

export const Route = createFileRoute("/audits")({ component: Page });

function Page() {
  return (
    <HospitalGate
      title="Audits"
      subtitle="Monthly and quarterly checks. Tick presence, expiry, damage, and labeling."
    >
      {(h) => <Audits hospital={h} />}
    </HospitalGate>
  );
}

function Audits({ hospital }: { hospital: HospitalPick }) {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [data, setData] = useState<Awaited<ReturnType<typeof listAudits>> | null>(null);
  const [cartId, setCartId] = useState("");
  const [auditType, setAuditType] = useState("monthly");
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    listAudits({ data: { hospitalId: hospital.id } })
      .then((d) => {
        setData(d);
        setCartId((c) => c || d.carts[0]?.id || "");
      })
      .catch((e: Error) => setError(e.message));
  }, [hospital.id]);

  if (error) return <p className="text-warn">{error}</p>;
  if (!data) return <p className="text-muted">Loading audits…</p>;

  const canAudit = ["hospital_admin", "pharmacy", "quality", "super_admin"].includes(data.role);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {canAudit ? (
        <form
          className="flex flex-wrap items-end gap-2 rounded-card border border-line bg-surface p-4"
          onSubmit={async (e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            try {
              const res = await startAudit({
                data: { hospitalId: hospital.id, cartId, auditType },
              });
              navigate({ to: "/audits/$auditId", params: { auditId: res.id } });
            } catch (err) {
              setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Could not start");
            }
          }}
        >
          <label className="min-w-48 flex-1 text-sm">
            Cart
            <select
              value={cartId}
              onChange={(e) => setCartId(e.target.value)}
              className="mt-1 block min-h-11 w-full rounded-lg border border-line bg-bg px-3"
            >
              {data.carts.map((c) => (
                <option key={c.id} value={c.id}>
                  {c.name}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </label>
          <label className="text-sm">
            Cycle
            <select
              value={auditType}
              onChange={(e) => setAuditType(e.target.value)}
              className="mt-1 block min-h-11 rounded-lg border border-line bg-bg px-3"
            >
              <option value="monthly">Monthly</option>
              <option value="quarterly">Quarterly</option>
            </select>
          </label>
          <button type="submit" className="min-h-11 rounded-full bg-primary px-5 text-primary-ink">
            Start audit
          </button>
        </form>
      ) : (
        <p className="text-sm text-muted">Managers can review audits. Pharmacy, quality, or an admin starts them.</p>
      )}
      <ul className="divide-y divide-line overflow-hidden rounded-card border border-line bg-surface">
        {data.audits.length === 0 ? (
          <li className="px-4 py-6 text-sm text-muted">No audits recorded for this hospital yet.</li>
        ) : null}
        {data.audits.map((a) => (
          <li key={a.id}>
            <button
              type="button"
              className="flex w-full items-center justify-between gap-3 px-4 py-3 text-left"
              onClick={() => navigate({ to: "/audits/$auditId", params: { auditId: a.id } })}
            >
              <span>
                <span className="block font-medium">{a.cart_name}</span>
                <span className="text-sm capitalize text-muted">
                  {a.audit_type} · {a.status}
                  {a.gaps ? ` · ${a.gaps} gaps` : " · complete"}
                </span>
              </span>
              <span className="text-sm text-primary">Open</span>
            </button>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    </div>
  );
}


========== FILE: src/routes/audits.$auditId.tsx ==========

import { createFileRoute } from "@tanstack/react-router";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { HospitalGate, type HospitalPick } from "@/components/shell";
import { getAudit, saveLine, setAuditStatus } from "@/lib/crash/api";

export const Route = createFileRoute("/audits/$auditId")({ component: Page });

const STATUSES = [
  { id: "present", label: "Present" },
  { id: "absent", label: "Absent" },
  { id: "expired", label: "Expired" },
  { id: "near_expiry", label: "Near expiry" },
  { id: "damaged", label: "Damaged" },
] as const;

const LABELS = [
  { id: "", label: "Label ok" },
  { id: "missing", label: "Missing label" },
  { id: "wrong", label: "Wrong label" },
  { id: "incomplete", label: "Incomplete label" },
] as const;

function Page() {
  const { auditId } = Route.useParams();
  return (
    <HospitalGate title="Checklist" subtitle="Work drawer by drawer. Changes save as you go while the audit is a draft.">
      {(h) => <Sheet hospital={h} auditId={auditId} />}
    </HospitalGate>
  );
}

type Line = Awaited<ReturnType<typeof getAudit>>["lines"][number];

function Sheet({ hospital, auditId }: { hospital: HospitalPick; auditId: string }) {
  const [pack, setPack] = useState<Awaited<ReturnType<typeof getAudit>> | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [remarks, setRemarks] = useState("");

  async function load() {
    const next = await getAudit({ data: { hospitalId: hospital.id, auditId } });
    setPack(next);
    setRemarks(next.audit.remarks);
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    load().catch((e: Error) => setError(e.message));
  }, [hospital.id, auditId]);

  if (error) return <p className="text-warn">{error}</p>;
  if (!pack) return <p className="text-muted">Loading checklist…</p>;

  const drawers = [...new Set(pack.lines.map((l) => l.drawer_name))];
  const gaps = pack.lines.filter((l) => l.line_status !== "present" || l.label_note).length;
  const draft = pack.audit.status === "draft";
  const canEdit = draft && ["hospital_admin", "pharmacy", "quality", "super_admin"].includes(pack.role);
  const canClose = ["hospital_admin", "quality", "manager", "super_admin"].includes(pack.role);

  async function patch(line: Line, partial: Partial<Line>) {
    const next = { ...line, ...partial };
    setPack((p) =>
      p ? { ...p, lines: p.lines.map((l) => (l.id === line.id ? next : l)) } : p,
    );
    await saveLine({
      data: {
        hospitalId: hospital.id,
        lineId: line.id,
        lineStatus: next.line_status,
        labelNote: next.label_note,
        remarks: next.remarks,
      },
    });
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-end justify-between gap-3">
        <div>
          <p className="font-display text-2xl">{pack.audit.cart_name}</p>
          <p className="text-sm capitalize text-muted">
            {pack.audit.location} · {pack.audit.audit_type} · {pack.audit.status} · {gaps} observations
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
          {canEdit ? (
            <button
              type="button"
              className="min-h-11 rounded-full bg-primary px-4 text-primary-ink"
              onClick={() =>
                setAuditStatus({
                  data: { hospitalId: hospital.id, auditId, status: "submitted", remarks },
                }).then(load)
              }
            >
              Submit
            </button>
          ) : null}
          {canClose && pack.audit.status === "submitted" ? (
            <button
              type="button"
              className="min-h-11 rounded-full border border-line bg-surface px-4"
              onClick={() =>
                setAuditStatus({
                  data: { hospitalId: hospital.id, auditId, status: "closed", remarks },
                }).then(load)
              }
            >
              Close
            </button>
          ) : null}
        </div>
      </div>
      <label className="block text-sm">
        Overall remarks
        <textarea
          value={remarks}
          onChange={(e) => setRemarks(e.target.value)}
          onBlur={() =>
            setAuditStatus({
              data: { hospitalId: hospital.id, auditId, status: pack.audit.status, remarks },
            })
          }
          className="mt-1 min-h-20 w-full rounded-lg border border-line bg-surface px-3 py-2"
        />
      </label>
      {drawers.map((name) => (
        <section key={name} className="overflow-hidden rounded-card border border-line bg-surface">
          <h2 className="border-b border-line px-4 py-3 font-medium">{name}</h2>
          <ul>
            {pack.lines
              .filter((l) => l.drawer_name === name)
              .map((line) => (
                <li key={line.id} className="grid gap-2 border-b border-line px-4 py-3 last:border-0 md:grid-cols-[1.2fr_1fr_1fr]">
                  <div>
                    <p className="font-medium">{line.item_name}</p>
                    <p className="text-sm text-muted">Fixed qty {line.fixed_qty}</p>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1">
                    {STATUSES.map((s) => (
                      <button
                        key={s.id}
                        type="button"
                        disabled={!canEdit}
                        onClick={() => patch(line, { line_status: s.id })}
                        className={`min-h-10 rounded-full px-3 text-sm ${
                          line.line_status === s.id
                            ? s.id === "present"
                              ? "bg-ok text-primary-ink"
                              : "bg-warn text-primary-ink"
                            : "bg-bg"
                        }`}
                      >
                        {s.label}
                      </button>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                  <select
                    disabled={!canEdit}
                    value={line.label_note}
                    onChange={(e) => patch(line, { label_note: e.target.value })}
                    className="min-h-11 rounded-lg border border-line bg-bg px-3 text-sm"
                  >
                    {LABELS.map((l) => (
                      <option key={l.id} value={l.id}>
                        {l.label}
                      </option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </li>
              ))}
          </ul>
        </section>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}


========== FILE: src/components/shell.tsx ==========

import { Link, useNavigate } from "@tanstack/react-router";
import { useEffect, useState, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { ClipboardCheck, LayoutDashboard, Package, Plus, Truck } from "lucide-react";
import { RedirectToSignIn, UserButton } from "@/lib/auth/gates";
import { useCurrentUserState } from "@/lib/auth/use-current-user";
import { createHospital, getWorkspace } from "@/lib/crash/api";
import { roleLabel } from "@/lib/crash/catalog";

const KEY = "cartcheck-hospital";

export type HospitalPick = { id: string; name: string; code: string; role: string };

export function HospitalGate({
  title,
  subtitle,
  children,
}: {
  title: string;
  subtitle?: string;
  children: (hospital: HospitalPick) => ReactNode;
}) {
  const { user, isPending } = useCurrentUserState();
  const [hospital, setHospital] = useState<HospitalPick | null>(null);
  const [hospitals, setHospitals] = useState<HospitalPick[]>([]);
  const [empty, setEmpty] = useState(false);
  const [isSuper, setIsSuper] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  async function load() {
    const ws = await getWorkspace();
    setHospitals(ws.hospitals);
    setIsSuper(ws.isSuper);
    if (!ws.hospitals.length) {
      setEmpty(true);
      setHospital(null);
      return;
    }
    setEmpty(false);
    const saved = localStorage.getItem(KEY);
    const pick = ws.hospitals.find((h) => h.id === saved) ?? ws.hospitals[0];
    setHospital(pick);
    localStorage.setItem(KEY, pick.id);
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!user) return;
    load().catch((e: Error) => setError(e.message));
  }, [user?.id]);

  if (isPending || (user && !hospital && !empty && !error)) {
    return <main className="grid min-h-screen place-items-center text-muted">Loading CartCheck…</main>;
  }
  if (!user) return <RedirectToSignIn />;
  if (error) return <main className="mx-auto max-w-lg p-8 text-warn">{error}</main>;
  if (empty || !hospital) {
    return (
      <main className="mx-auto max-w-lg px-4 py-12">
        <p className="font-display text-3xl text-ink">
          {isSuper ? "Add the first hospital" : "Waiting for a hospital"}
        </p>
        <p className="mt-2 text-muted">
          {isSuper
            ? "Only Super Admin can open a hospital. Each one keeps its own crash carts and item list."
            : "Ask Super Admin to add your hospital and invite your work email."}
        </p>
        {isSuper ? (
          <CreateHospital
            onCreated={async (id) => {
              localStorage.setItem(KEY, id);
              await load();
              navigate({ to: "/" });
            }}
          />
        ) : null}
      </main>
    );
  }

  const links = [
    { to: "/", label: "Floor", icon: LayoutDashboard },
    { to: "/carts", label: "Carts", icon: Truck },
    { to: "/items", label: "Items", icon: Package },
    { to: "/audits", label: "Audits", icon: ClipboardCheck },
  ] as const;

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen">
      <header className="border-b border-line bg-surface">
        <div className="mx-auto flex max-w-6xl flex-wrap items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3">
          <Link to="/" className="font-display text-2xl tracking-tight text-primary">
            CartCheck
          </Link>
          <select
            className="min-h-11 w-full max-w-xs rounded-lg border border-line bg-bg px-3 py-2 text-sm sm:ml-2 sm:w-auto"
            value={hospital.id}
            onChange={(e) => {
              localStorage.setItem(KEY, e.target.value);
              const next = hospitals.find((h) => h.id === e.target.value);
              if (next) setHospital(next);
            }}
          >
            {hospitals.map((h) => (
              <option key={h.id} value={h.id}>
                {h.name} · {roleLabel(h.role)}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
          <div className="ml-auto">
            <UserButton />
          </div>
        </div>
        <nav className="mx-auto flex max-w-6xl gap-1 overflow-x-auto px-3 pb-3">
          {links.map((l) => (
            <Link
              key={l.to}
              to={l.to}
              activeOptions={{ exact: l.to === "/" }}
              activeProps={{
                className:
                  "inline-flex min-h-11 items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-primary px-4 text-sm text-primary-ink",
              }}
              inactiveProps={{
                className:
                  "inline-flex min-h-11 items-center gap-2 rounded-full px-4 text-sm text-ink hover:bg-bg",
              }}
            >
              <l.icon size={16} />
              {l.label}
            </Link>
          ))}
        </nav>
      </header>
      <main className="mx-auto max-w-6xl px-4 py-6">
        <h1 className="font-display text-3xl text-ink">{title}</h1>
        {subtitle ? <p className="mt-1 max-w-2xl text-muted">{subtitle}</p> : null}
        <div className="mt-6">{children(hospital)}</div>
      </main>
    </div>
  );
}

function CreateHospital({ onCreated }: { onCreated: (id: string) => Promise<void> }) {
  const [name, setName] = useState("");
  const [code, setCode] = useState("");
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  return (
    <form
      className="mt-6 space-y-3 rounded-card border border-line bg-surface p-4"
      onSubmit={async (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        setBusy(true);
        setError("");
        try {
          const res = await createHospital({ data: { name, code } });
          await onCreated(res.id);
        } catch (err) {
          setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Could not create hospital");
        } finally {
          setBusy(false);
        }
      }}
    >
      <label className="block text-sm">
        Hospital name
        <input
          className="mt-1 min-h-11 w-full rounded-lg border border-line bg-bg px-3"
          value={name}
          onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)}
          placeholder="City General"
          required
        />
      </label>
      <label className="block text-sm">
        Short code
        <input
          className="mt-1 min-h-11 w-full rounded-lg border border-line bg-bg px-3 uppercase"
          value={code}
          onChange={(e) => setCode(e.target.value)}
          placeholder="CGH"
          required
        />
      </label>
      {error ? <p className="text-sm text-warn">{error}</p> : null}
      <button
        type="submit"
        disabled={busy}
        className="inline-flex min-h-11 items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-primary px-5 text-primary-ink disabled:opacity-60"
      >
        <Plus size={16} />
        {busy ? "Creating…" : "Create hospital"}
      </button>
      <p className="text-sm text-muted">
        A standard medicine and surgical list is loaded with three starter carts: ICU, Emergency, and
        Ward. Every line can be changed later.
      </p>
    </form>
  );
}

export const DRAWER_NAMES = ["Floor 1", "Floor 2", "Floor 3", "Floor 4"] as const;

export const ROLES = ["hospital_admin", "pharmacy", "quality", "manager"] as const;
export type Role = (typeof ROLES)[number];

export function roleLabel(role: string) {
  switch (role) {
    case "super_admin":
      return "Super admin";
    case "hospital_admin":
      return "Hospital admin";
    case "pharmacy":
      return "Pharmacy";
    case "quality":
      return "Quality";
    case "manager":
      return "Manager";
    default:
      return role;
  }
}


========== FILE: src/lib/crash/api.ts ==========

import { createServerFn } from "@tanstack/react-start";
import { authMiddleware } from "@/lib/auth/middleware";
import { getSql } from "@/lib/db";
import { DRAWER_NAMES, ROLES, STARTER_ITEMS, type Role } from "@/lib/crash/catalog";

function id() {
  return crypto.randomUUID();
}

type Sql = Awaited<ReturnType<typeof getSql>>;

const SUPER_EMAIL = "superadmin@cartcheck.local";

async function callerEmail(sql: Sql, userId: string) {
  const users = await sql<{ email: string }>`select email from "user" where id = ${userId}`;
  return (users[0]?.email ?? "").toLowerCase();
}

export const ensureSuperAdmin = createServerFn({ method: "POST" }).handler(async () => {
  const sql = await getSql();
  const existing = await sql<{ id: string }>`
    select id from "user" where lower(email) = ${SUPER_EMAIL}
  `;
  if (existing[0]) return { ready: true };
  const { auth } = await import("@/lib/auth/server");
  await auth.api.signUpEmail({
    body: { email: SUPER_EMAIL, password: "SuperAdmin@123", name: "Super Admin" },
  });
  return { ready: true };
});

async function memberRole(sql: Sql, userId: string, hospitalId: string) {
  if ((await callerEmail(sql, userId)) === SUPER_EMAIL) return "hospital_admin";
  const rows = await sql<{ role: string }>`
    select role from memberships where user_id = ${userId} and hospital_id = ${hospitalId}
  `;
  return rows[0]?.role ?? null;
}

async function assertMember(sql: Sql, userId: string, hospitalId: string, roles?: Role[]) {
  const role = await memberRole(sql, userId, hospitalId);
  if (!role) throw new Error("You are not a member of this hospital.");
  if (roles && !roles.includes(role as Role)) throw new Error("Your role cannot do that.");
  return role;
}

async function assertSuper(sql: Sql, userId: string) {
  if ((await callerEmail(sql, userId)) !== SUPER_EMAIL) {
    throw new Error("Only Super Admin can add hospitals.");
  }
}

const MANAGE: Role[] = ["hospital_admin"];
const AUDIT: Role[] = ["hospital_admin", "pharmacy", "quality"];
const CLOSE: Role[] = ["hospital_admin", "quality", "manager"];

export const getWorkspace = createServerFn({ method: "GET" })
  .middleware([authMiddleware])
  .handler(async ({ context }) => {
    const sql = await getSql();
    const users = await sql<{ id: string; email: string; name: string }>`
      select id, email, name from "user" where id = ${context.userId}
    `;
    const me = users[0];
    const isSuper = (me?.email ?? "").toLowerCase() === SUPER_EMAIL;
    if (me?.email && !isSuper) {
      const pending = await sql<{ id: string; hospital_id: string; role: string }>`
        select id, hospital_id, role from invites where lower(email) = lower(${me.email})
      `;
      for (const inv of pending) {
        await sql`
          insert into memberships (user_id, hospital_id, role)
          values (${context.userId}, ${inv.hospital_id}, ${inv.role})
          on conflict (user_id, hospital_id) do nothing
        `;
        await sql`delete from invites where id = ${inv.id}`;
      }
    }
    const hospitals = isSuper
      ? await sql<{ id: string; name: string; code: string; role: string }>`
          select id, name, code, ${"super_admin"} as role from hospitals order by name
        `
      : await sql<{ id: string; name: string; code: string; role: string }>`
          select h.id, h.name, h.code, m.role
          from memberships m
          join hospitals h on h.id = m.hospital_id
          where m.user_id = ${context.userId}
          order by h.name
        `;
    return {
      user: { id: context.userId, email: me?.email ?? "", name: me?.name ?? "" },
      isSuper,
      hospitals,
    };
  });

export const createHospital = createServerFn({ method: "POST" })
  .middleware([authMiddleware])
  .validator((data: { name: string; code: string }) => {
    const name = data.name.trim();
    const code = data.code.trim().toUpperCase();
    if (name.length < 2 || code.length < 2) throw new Error("Name and short code are required.");
    return { name, code };
  })
  .handler(async ({ context, data }) => {
    const sql = await getSql();
    await assertSuper(sql, context.userId);
    const hospitalId = id();
    await sql`
      insert into hospitals (id, name, code, created_by)
      values (${hospitalId}, ${data.name}, ${data.code}, ${context.userId})
    `;
    await sql`
      insert into memberships (user_id, hospital_id, role)
      values (${context.userId}, ${hospitalId}, ${"hospital_admin"})
    `;

    for (const item of STARTER_ITEMS) {
      await sql`
        insert into items (id, hospital_id, name, kind, category, strength)
        values (${id()}, ${hospitalId}, ${item.name}, ${item.kind}, ${item.category}, ${item.strength})
      `;
    }

    const seeds = [
      { name: "ICU Crash Cart", location: "ICU", cart_type: "ICU" },
      { name: "Emergency Crash Cart", location: "Emergency", cart_type: "Emergency" },
      { name: "Ward Crash Cart", location: "Medical ward", cart_type: "Ward" },
    ];
    for (const seed of seeds) {
      const cartId = id();
      await sql`
        insert into carts (id, hospital_id, name, location, cart_type)
        values (${cartId}, ${hospitalId}, ${seed.name}, ${seed.location}, ${seed.cart_type})
      `;
      for (let i = 0; i < DRAWER_NAMES.length; i++) {
        await sql`
          insert into drawers (id, cart_id, sort_order, name)
          values (${id()}, ${cartId}, ${i}, ${DRAWER_NAMES[i]})
        `;
      }
    }
    return { id: hospitalId };
  });

export const getDashboard = createServerFn({ method: "GET" })
  .middleware([authMiddleware])
  .validator((data: { hospitalId: string }) => data)
  .handler(async ({ context, data }) => {
    const sql = await getSql();
    const role = await assertMember(sql, context.userId, data.hospitalId);
    const isSuper = (await callerEmail(sql, context.userId)) === SUPER_EMAIL;
    const carts = await sql<{ id: string; name: string; location: string; cart_type: string }>`
      select id, name, location, cart_type from carts
      where hospital_id = ${data.hospitalId}
      order by name
    `;
    const open = await sql<{ n: number }>`
      select count(*)::int as n from audits
      where hospital_id = ${data.hospitalId} and status <> 'closed'
    `;
    const recent = await sql<{
      id: string;
      cart_name: string;
      audit_type: string;
      status: string;
      created_at: string;
    }>`
      select a.id, c.name as cart_name, a.audit_type, a.status, a.created_at::text as created_at
      from audits a
      join carts c on c.id = a.cart_id
      where a.hospital_id = ${data.hospitalId}
      order by a.created_at desc
      limit 8
    `;
    const gaps = await sql<{ n: number }>`
      select count(*)::int as n
      from audit_lines l
      join audits a on a.id = l.audit_id
      where a.hospital_id = ${data.hospitalId}
        and a.status <> 'closed'
        and l.line_status <> 'present'
    `;
    return {
      role: isSuper ? "super_admin" : role,
      isSuper,
      cartCount: carts.length,
      openAudits: open[0]?.n ?? 0,
      openGaps: gaps[0]?.n ?? 0,
      carts,
      recent,
    };
  });

export const listItems = createServerFn({ method: "GET" })
  .middleware([authMiddleware])
  .validator((data: { hospitalId: string }) => data)
  .handler(async ({ context, data }) => {
    const sql = await getSql();
    const role = await assertMember(sql, context.userId, data.hospitalId);
    const isSuper = (await callerEmail(sql, context.userId)) === SUPER_EMAIL;
    const items = await sql<{
      id: string;
      name: string;
      kind: string;
      category: string;
      strength: string;
      is_active: boolean;
    }>`
      select id, name, kind, category, strength, is_active
      from items where hospital_id = ${data.hospitalId}
      order by kind, category, name
    `;
    return { role: isSuper ? "super_admin" : role, items };
  });

export const addItem = createServerFn({ method: "POST" })
  .middleware([authMiddleware])
  .validator((data: { hospitalId: string; name: string; kind: string; category: string; strength: string }) => {
    if (!data.name.trim()) throw new Error("Name is required.");
    if (!["medicine", "surgical", "misc"].includes(data.kind)) throw new Error("Pick medicine, surgical, or misc.");
    return {
      ...data,
      name: data.name.trim(),
      category: data.category.trim() || "General",
      strength: data.strength.trim(),
    };
  })
  .handler(async ({ context, data }) => {
    const sql = await getSql();
    await assertMember(sql, context.userId, data.hospitalId, MANAGE);
    const itemId = id();
    await sql`
      insert into items (id, hospital_id, name, kind, category, strength)
      values (${itemId}, ${data.hospitalId}, ${data.name}, ${data.kind}, ${data.category}, ${data.strength})
    `;
    return { id: itemId };
  });

export const listCarts = createServerFn({ method: "GET" })
  .middleware([authMiddleware])
  .validator((data: { hospitalId: string }) => data)
  .handler(async ({ context, data }) => {
    const sql = await getSql();
    const role = await assertMember(sql, context.userId, data.hospitalId);
    const isSuper = (await callerEmail(sql, context.userId)) === SUPER_EMAIL;
    const carts = await sql<{
      id: string;
      name: string;
      location: string;
      cart_type: string;
      drawers: number;
      lines: number;
    }>`
      select c.id, c.name, c.location, c.cart_type,
        (select count(*)::int from drawers d where d.cart_id = c.id) as drawers,
        (select count(*)::int from cart_items ci join drawers d on d.id = ci.drawer_id where d.cart_id = c.id) as lines
      from carts c
      where c.hospital_id = ${data.hospitalId}
      order by c.name
    `;
    return { role: isSuper ? "super_admin" : role, carts };
  });

export const createCart = createServerFn({ method: "POST" })
  .middleware([authMiddleware])
  .validator((data: { hospitalId: string; name: string; location: string; cartType: string }) => {
    if (!data.name.trim() || !data.location.trim()) throw new Error("Name and location are required.");
    return { ...data, name: data.name.trim(), location: data.location.trim() };
  })
  .handler(async ({ context, data }) => {
    const sql = await getSql();
    await assertMember(sql, context.userId, data.hospitalId, MANAGE);
    const cartId = id();
    await sql`
      insert into carts (id, hospital_id, name, location, cart_type)
      values (${cartId}, ${data.hospitalId}, ${data.name}, ${data.location}, ${data.cartType || "Ward"})
    `;
    for (let i = 0; i < DRAWER_NAMES.length; i++) {
      await sql`
        insert into drawers (id, cart_id, sort_order, name)
        values (${id()}, ${cartId}, ${i}, ${DRAWER_NAMES[i]})
      `;
    }
    return { id: cartId };
  });

export const getCart = createServerFn({ method: "GET" })
  .middleware([authMiddleware])
  .validator((data: { hospitalId: string; cartId: string }) => data)
  .handler(async ({ context, data }) => {
    const sql = await getSql();
    const role = await assertMember(sql, context.userId, data.hospitalId);
    const isSuper = (await callerEmail(sql, context.userId)) === SUPER_EMAIL;
    const carts = await sql<{ id: string; name: string; location: string; cart_type: string }>`
      select id, name, location, cart_type from carts
      where id = ${data.cartId} and hospital_id = ${data.hospitalId}
    `;
    const cart = carts[0];
    if (!cart) throw new Error("Cart not found.");
    const drawers = await sql<{ id: string; name: string; sort_order: number }>`
      select id, name, sort_order from drawers where cart_id = ${data.cartId} order by sort_order
    `;
    const lines = await sql<{
      id: string;
      drawer_id: string;
      item_id: string;
      name: string;
      kind: string;
      strength: string;
      fixed_qty: number;
    }>`
      select ci.id, ci.drawer_id, ci.item_id, i.name, i.kind, i.strength, ci.fixed_qty
      from cart_items ci
      join items i on i.id = ci.item_id
      join drawers d on d.id = ci.drawer_id
      where d.cart_id = ${data.cartId}
      order by i.name
    `;
    const catalog = await sql<{ id: string; name: string; kind: string; strength: string }>`
      select id, name, kind, strength from items
      where hospital_id = ${data.hospitalId} and is_active = true
      order by name
    `;
    return { role: isSuper ? "super_admin" : role, cart, drawers, lines, catalog };
  });

export const assignItem = createServerFn({ method: "POST" })
  .middleware([authMiddleware])
  .validator((data: { hospitalId: string; drawerId: string; itemId: string; qty: number }) => data)
  .handler(async ({ context, data }) => {
    const sql = await getSql();
    await assertMember(sql, context.userId, data.hospitalId, MANAGE);
    const ok = await sql<{ id: string }>`
      select d.id from drawers d
      join carts c on c.id = d.cart_id
      where d.id = ${data.drawerId} and c.hospital_id = ${data.hospitalId}
    `;
    if (!ok[0]) throw new Error("Floor not found.");
    await sql`
      insert into cart_items (id, drawer_id, item_id, fixed_qty)
      values (${id()}, ${data.drawerId}, ${data.itemId}, ${Math.max(1, data.qty || 1)})
    `;
    return { ok: true };
  });

export const addFloorItem = createServerFn({ method: "POST" })
  .middleware([authMiddleware])
  .validator(
    (data: { hospitalId: string; drawerId: string; name: string; kind: string; strength: string; qty: number }) => {
      if (!data.name.trim()) throw new Error("Name is required.");
      if (!["medicine", "surgical", "misc"].includes(data.kind)) throw new Error("Pick a type.");
      return { ...data, name: data.name.trim(), strength: data.strength.trim() };
    },
  )
  .handler(async ({ context, data }) => {
    const sql = await getSql();
    await assertMember(sql, context.userId, data.hospitalId, MANAGE);
    const ok = await sql<{ id: string }>`
      select d.id from drawers d
      join carts c on c.id = d.cart_id
      where d.id = ${data.drawerId} and c.hospital_id = ${data.hospitalId}
    `;
    if (!ok[0]) throw new Error("Floor not found.");
    const itemId = id();
    await sql`
      insert into items (id, hospital_id, name, kind, category, strength)
      values (${itemId}, ${data.hospitalId}, ${data.name}, ${data.kind}, ${data.kind}, ${data.strength})
    `;
    await sql`
      insert into cart_items (id, drawer_id, item_id, fixed_qty)
      values (${id()}, ${data.drawerId}, ${itemId}, ${Math.max(1, Number(data.qty) || 1)})
    `;
    return { id: itemId };
  });

export const listAudits = createServerFn({ method: "GET" })
  .middleware([authMiddleware])
  .validator((data: { hospitalId: string }) => data)
  .handler(async ({ context, data }) => {
    const sql = await getSql();
    const role = await assertMember(sql, context.userId, data.hospitalId);
    const isSuper = (await callerEmail(sql, context.userId)) === SUPER_EMAIL;
    const audits = await sql<{
      id: string;
      cart_id: string;
      cart_name: string;
      audit_type: string;
      status: string;
      created_at: string;
      gaps: number;
    }>`
      select a.id, a.cart_id, c.name as cart_name, a.audit_type, a.status,
        a.created_at::text as created_at,
        (select count(*)::int from audit_lines l where l.audit_id = a.id and l.line_status <> 'present') as gaps
      from audits a
      join carts c on c.id = a.cart_id
      where a.hospital_id = ${data.hospitalId}
      order by a.created_at desc
    `;
    const carts = await sql<{ id: string; name: string }>`
      select id, name from carts where hospital_id = ${data.hospitalId} order by name
    `;
    return { role: isSuper ? "super_admin" : role, audits, carts };
  });

export const startAudit = createServerFn({ method: "POST" })
  .middleware([authMiddleware])
  .validator((data: { hospitalId: string; cartId: string; auditType: string }) => {
    if (data.auditType !== "monthly" && data.auditType !== "quarterly") {
      throw new Error("Choose monthly or quarterly.");
    }
    return data;
  })
  .handler(async ({ context, data }) => {
    const sql = await getSql();
    await assertMember(sql, context.userId, data.hospitalId, AUDIT);
    const cart = await sql<{ id: string }>`
      select id from carts where id = ${data.cartId} and hospital_id = ${data.hospitalId}
    `;
    if (!cart[0]) throw new Error("Cart not found.");
    const auditId = id();
    await sql`
      insert into audits (id, hospital_id, cart_id, audit_type, auditor_id, status)
      values (${auditId}, ${data.hospitalId}, ${data.cartId}, ${data.auditType}, ${context.userId}, ${"draft"})
    `;
    const lines = await sql<{ id: string; item_name: string; drawer_name: string; fixed_qty: number }>`
      select ci.id, i.name as item_name, d.name as drawer_name, ci.fixed_qty
      from cart_items ci
      join items i on i.id = ci.item_id
      join drawers d on d.id = ci.drawer_id
      where d.cart_id = ${data.cartId}
      order by d.sort_order, i.name
    `;
    for (const line of lines) {
      await sql`
        insert into audit_lines (id, audit_id, cart_item_id, item_name, drawer_name, fixed_qty, line_status)
        values (${id()}, ${auditId}, ${line.id}, ${line.item_name}, ${line.drawer_name}, ${line.fixed_qty}, ${"present"})
      `;
    }
    return { id: auditId };
  });

export const getAudit = createServerFn({ method: "GET" })
  .middleware([authMiddleware])
  .validator((data: { hospitalId: string; auditId: string }) => data)
  .handler(async ({ context, data }) => {
    const sql = await getSql();
    const role = await assertMember(sql, context.userId, data.hospitalId);
    const isSuper = (await callerEmail(sql, context.userId)) === SUPER_EMAIL;
    const rows = await sql<{
      id: string;
      cart_name: string;
      location: string;
      audit_type: string;
      status: string;
      remarks: string;
      created_at: string;
    }>`
      select a.id, c.name as cart_name, c.location, a.audit_type, a.status, a.remarks,
        a.created_at::text as created_at
      from audits a
      join carts c on c.id = a.cart_id
      where a.id = ${data.auditId} and a.hospital_id = ${data.hospitalId}
    `;
    const audit = rows[0];
    if (!audit) throw new Error("Audit not found.");
    const lines = await sql<{
      id: string;
      item_name: string;
      drawer_name: string;
      fixed_qty: number;
      line_status: string;
      label_note: string;
      remarks: string;
    }>`
      select id, item_name, drawer_name, fixed_qty, line_status, label_note, remarks
      from audit_lines where audit_id = ${data.auditId}
      order by drawer_name, item_name
    `;
    return { role: isSuper ? "super_admin" : role, audit, lines };
  });

export const saveLine = createServerFn({ method: "POST" })
  .middleware([authMiddleware])
  .validator(
    (data: { hospitalId: string; lineId: string; lineStatus: string; labelNote: string; remarks: string }) => data,
  )
  .handler(async ({ context, data }) => {
    const sql = await getSql();
    await assertMember(sql, context.userId, data.hospitalId, AUDIT);
    const allowed = ["present", "absent", "expired", "damaged", "near_expiry"];
    if (!allowed.includes(data.lineStatus)) throw new Error("Invalid status.");
    await sql`
      update audit_lines l set
        line_status = ${data.lineStatus},
        label_note = ${data.labelNote},
        remarks = ${data.remarks}
      from audits a
      where l.id = ${data.lineId}
        and l.audit_id = a.id
        and a.hospital_id = ${data.hospitalId}
        and a.status = 'draft'
    `;
    return { ok: true };
  });

export const setAuditStatus = createServerFn({ method: "POST" })
  .middleware([authMiddleware])
  .validator((data: { hospitalId: string; auditId: string; status: string; remarks: string }) => data)
  .handler(async ({ context, data }) => {
    const sql = await getSql();
    const role = await assertMember(sql, context.userId, data.hospitalId);
    if (data.status === "submitted") {
      if (!AUDIT.includes(role as Role)) throw new Error("Your role cannot submit audits.");
    } else if (data.status === "closed" || data.status === "draft") {
      if (!CLOSE.includes(role as Role) && !(data.status === "draft" && AUDIT.includes(role as Role))) {
        throw new Error("Your role cannot change this audit.");
      }
    } else {
      throw new Error("Invalid status.");
    }
    await sql`
      update audits set status = ${data.status}, remarks = ${data.remarks}
      where id = ${data.auditId} and hospital_id = ${data.hospitalId}
    `;
    return { ok: true };
  });

export const inviteMember = createServerFn({ method: "POST" })
  .middleware([authMiddleware])
  .validator((data: { hospitalId: string; email: string; role: string }) => {
    const email = data.email.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!email.includes("@")) throw new Error("Enter a valid email.");
    if (!ROLES.includes(data.role as Role)) throw new Error("Pick a role.");
    return { ...data, email, role: data.role as Role };
  })
  .handler(async ({ context, data }) => {
    const sql = await getSql();
    await assertMember(sql, context.userId, data.hospitalId, MANAGE);
    const existing = await sql<{ id: string }>`
      select id from "user" where lower(email) = ${data.email}
    `;
    if (existing[0]) {
      await sql`
        insert into memberships (user_id, hospital_id, role)
        values (${existing[0].id}, ${data.hospitalId}, ${data.role})
        on conflict (user_id, hospital_id) do update set role = ${data.role}
      `;
      return { joined: true };
    }
    await sql`
      insert into invites (id, hospital_id, email, role)
      values (${id()}, ${data.hospitalId}, ${data.email}, ${data.role})
      on conflict (hospital_id, email) do update set role = ${data.role}
    `;
    return { joined: false };
  });

export const listMembers = createServerFn({ method: "GET" })
  .middleware([authMiddleware])
  .validator((data: { hospitalId: string }) => data)
  .handler(async ({ context, data }) => {
    const sql = await getSql();
    await assertMember(sql, context.userId, data.hospitalId);
    const members = await sql<{ email: string; name: string; role: string }>`
      select u.email, u.name, m.role
      from memberships m
      join "user" u on u.id = m.user_id
      where m.hospital_id = ${data.hospitalId}
      order by u.email
    `;
    const pending = await sql<{ email: string; role: string }>`
      select email, role from invites where hospital_id = ${data.hospitalId} order by email
    `;
    return { members, pending };
  });


========== FILE: src/routes/api/auth/$.ts ==========

import { createFileRoute } from "@tanstack/react-router";
import { auth } from "@/lib/auth/server";

export const Route = createFileRoute("/api/auth/$")({
  server: {
    handlers: {
      GET: ({ request }) => auth.handler(request),
      POST: ({ request }) => auth.handler(request),
    },
  },
});
